name: Independent-source Retrieval Corroboration
mechanism: Groups candidates by upstream provenance and requires consequential claims to be supported by multiple independently governed source domains or to abstain and escalate.
use_when: High-impact claims have genuinely independent evidence sources
Poisoning or single-source compromise is a material risk
avoid_when: All apparent sources derive from one shared upstream
The domain has one authoritative source that should not be outvoted
expected_effects: Reduced reliance on one poisoned or stale source
Visible evidence diversity for consequential claims
failure_modes: Mirrors are counted as independent sources
Several sources repeat the same upstream error
A true single authority is incorrectly rejected
